sn35.19:1.1: Yo bhikkhave cakkhum abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati ||
sn35.19:1.2: yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmī ||
sn35.19:1.5: Yo jivham abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati ||
sn35.19:1.6: yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || ||
sn35.19:1.8: Yo manam abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati ||
sn35.19:1.9: yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi || || 3
